notes: Extraction used only the provided Doc16 Raw + components imagery and visual inspection; no GT, Raw+wires, OCR, web, or prior Doc16 scripts were used.
BUS-480-B is used as a logical name for the lower unlabeled 480 V busbar that is visibly tied to BUS-480-A by CB-TIE-480AB and feeds the MCC feeder breakers.
Long busbars are modeled as logical bus nodes; matrix entries connect each visibly landed component/breaker to the bus rather than making all bus-connected devices pairwise adjacent.
Solid, dashed, and dotted wires were included where endpoints or filled junctions were visually clear. Crossings without dots were excluded or listed as uncertain.
MCC branch edges model the visible path MCC bus -> branch CB -> relay/contactor -> load -> ground/terminal box.
The dense dashed breaker-trip lines through selected safety load feeders are mostly captured only where direct component endpoints were readable; broader trip-bus membership is listed as uncertain.
